plugins.name: The Frozen Heart

Start a new pilot, land on Thallos, and visit the bar to begin. Includes its own documents folder with two encrypted files you're given access to later in the story — read it before you start.

plugins.name: EV Classic for Nova
plugins.author: Ambrosia Software (original); ported by andrews05
plugins.summary: The original Escape Velocity, faithfully ported onto the Nova engine.
plugins.description: A port of Ambrosia Software's original Escape Velocity — the first game in the series — onto the EV Nova engine, designed to look and feel as close to the 1996 original as possible. Includes optional fix plug-ins (manual flares, an AI rocket-range hack, and a bundle of gameplay bug fixes) alongside the main scenario. Requires the included "Sillycon" font for authentic interface text.

plugins.summary: The second game in the series, EV Override, ported onto the Nova engine.
plugins.description: A port of Ambrosia Software's EV Override — the second game in the series — onto the EV Nova engine. Designed to match the original's look and feel; several other catalog entries (EVO Extras, EVO Facelift, Cold Fusion for Nova) build on top of this one. Requires the included "Sillycon" font.

plugins.name: rEV
plugins.author: Kris Quistorff; rebuilt by andrews05
plugins.summary: A major graphics and feature-enhancement pack for EV Classic for Nova.
plugins.description: A graphical facelift and feature-enhancement pack for EV Classic for Nova, originally created by Kris Quistorff and rebuilt/expanded by andrews05. Ships as several optional pieces: rEV Data (small balanced feature enhancements, recommended), rEV xData (new outfits/weapons/ship variants), and rEV XL Ships (larger, more accurately-scaled ship sprites, best paired with xData). Install after EV Classic for Nova.
plugins.license: Fan-made plug-in. NovaSwift links to the author's original download and does not host or redistribute the file.

plugins.name: Cold Fusion for Nova
plugins.author: Dreamwave Studios; converted by Dr. Trowel
plugins.summary: A complete graphics replacement for EV Override, in thousands of colors.
plugins.description: A full graphics replacement for EV Override — re-textured ships, outfits, planets/stations, explosions, asteroids, and interface art — rendered in thousands of colors rather than the original's dithered 256. No new ships, outfits, or missions, just a visual overhaul. Ships as six separate pieces (interface, planets, ships in space, shipyard/outfitter pics, shots & rocks, sparse planets) so you can pick which parts you want; install on top of EV Override for Nova.
plugins.license: Fan-made plug-in. NovaSwift links to the author's original download and does not host or redistribute the file.

plugins.name: EVO Facelift
plugins.author: Tim Morgan (Lightning Bolt Software); repackaged by andrews05
plugins.summary: A graphical facelift for EV Override — map colors, new station art, a splash screen, and more.
plugins.description: A graphical facelift for EV Override for Nova, originally made by Tim Morgan of Lightning Bolt Software and repackaged for distribution by andrews05, with some fixes and rescaled sprites. Adds map colors, reorganized shipyard/outfitter art, new station sprites, and a 16-bit splash screen; bundles in Cold Fusion Planets and Sounds Galore. Not every component is required — Sounds Galore and the Range Extension plug are optional extras.
plugins.license: Fan-made plug-in. NovaSwift links to the author's original download and does not host or redistribute the file.

plugins.name: EVO Extras
plugins.author: andrews05
plugins.summary: Six small gameplay plug-ins for EV Override, from bug-fix-style tweaks to a new UE mission string.
plugins.description: A collection of six small, independent plug-ins for EV Override for Nova: Alien Artifact (reworks a classic Igadzra mission), Bonus Bays (unlocks purchasing UE/Voinian/Zidagar fighter bays), Mischievous Mods (a grab-bag of small annoyance fixes), Paaren Proceedings (a roughly 10-mission UE side story, with a quick-start pilot background to jump straight in), and Super Special (lets you keep extra weapons/shielding captured from certain named AI ships). Each comes in Facelift and non-Facelift variants; install only the ones you want.
plugins.license: Fan-made plug-in. NovaSwift links to the author's original download and does not host or redistribute the file.

plugins.description: A small gameplay plug-in that adjusts ship shield behavior. Ships with two variants: a standard version and one specifically built for compatibility with the ARPIA2 total conversion — install whichever matches the scenario you're playing.

plugins.summary: Ships take damage when they physically collide with each other.
plugins.description: A small gameplay plug-in that adds damage when ships collide with one another in flight — stock EV Nova has no collision damage between ships, so this adds a bit of extra risk to crowded dogfights and close flying.
plugins.license: Fan-made plug-in. NovaSwift links to the author's original download and does not host or redistribute the file.

plugins.author: andrews05
plugins.summary: Loosens missile tracking so incoming rockets are easier to dodge.
plugins.description: A small gameplay plug-in that reduces missile/rocket tracking accuracy, giving the player more of a chance to physically dodge incoming ordnance rather than relying purely on point-defense or countermeasures.
plugins.license: Fan-made plug-in. NovaSwift links to the author's original download and does not host or redistribute the file.

plugins.name: ARPIA2
plugins.author: Peter "Pace" Craddock and the ARPIA Team
plugins.summary: An acclaimed, puzzle-driven total conversion with a new galaxy, governments, and branching story.
plugins.description: A large, highly-regarded total conversion by Peter "Pace" Craddock and the ARPIA Team (graphics, ship art, planet art, mission design credited across the team in-readme). Features an original galaxy, new governments, and a branching story with missions that expect the player to actually think — read the included ReadMe before diving in, especially for the riddle-solving sections. Do not delete any of the extra files/folders the plug-in installs alongside itself.

plugins.name: White Dwarf
plugins.author: DrFive
plugins.summary: A fan sequel set a century after Nova, in a galaxy still recovering from a mysterious Calamity.
plugins.description: A fan sequel total conversion by DrFive, set roughly a hundred years after the events of Nova (and after the same author's Brave New Void). The galaxy is still recovering from a mysterious "Calamity" that warped and ravaged known space seventy years earlier — and something may be stirring beyond the hyperlanes. In open beta as of this writing; expect an actively-developed, still-evolving scenario.
plugins.license: Fan-made plug-in. NovaSwift links to the author's original download and does not host or redistribute the file.

plugins.name: Brave New Void
plugins.author: DrFive
plugins.summary: A large-scale rebalance and expansion of the base Nova scenario, not a new galaxy.
plugins.description: A "total expansion" plug-in for the base EV Nova scenario by DrFive (the same author as White Dwarf): rebalances combat, fixes bugs and design issues in the original game, and adds new ships, missions, outfits, and places to explore that aim to feel native to the Nova universe. Many of the stronger ship variants are gated behind side missions, hidden upgrades, or rare shipyards rather than being available outright.
plugins.license: Fan-made plug-in. NovaSwift links to the author's original download and does not host or redistribute the file.

plugins.name: Starfleet Adventures
plugins.author: Uncle Twitchy, later Dr. Trowel and astor
plugins.summary: A Star Trek: The Original Series total conversion with an unusually large map and no fighters.
plugins.description: A total conversion recasting Nova as 23rd-century Star Trek (The Original Series and the early movies). Notable design twists: no fighters, mostly Federation ships, "upgrades" come from hiring command crew rather than buying hardware, and most ships are inertialess, which changes combat significantly from stock Nova. Started by Uncle Twitchy and later carried on by Dr. Trowel and then astor; development has been quiet since its public alpha, so treat this as an unfinished but substantial labor of love rather than a polished release.
plugins.license: Fan-made plug-in. NovaSwift links to the author's original download and does not host or redistribute the file.
